no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: QuidelOrtho is an in-vitro diagnostics (IVD) company. Its product portfolio consists exclusively of diagnostic testing platforms (VITROS clinical chemistry/immunoassay systems, ORTHO VISION transfusion medicine, SOFIA/QUICKVUE rapid antigen, LYRA/SOLANA molecular, point-of-care). The company does not develop therapeutics and has no Phase 1/2/3 drug trials.
